newsitem.title: USA: VF comfortable with growth estimate rise.
newsitem.headline: VF comfortable with growth estimate rise.

text.p: VF Corp said on Wednesday that it is comfortable with raising its fiscal year earnings growth estimates to the 12 to 15 percent range.
Earlier in the day the company reported third quarter earnings of $1.39, above a First Call consensus of $1.32.

"With three quarters of the year behind us, we are comfortable with increasing our full year earnings growth expectations up to the 12% to 15% range, excluding the effects of special charges taken in 1995, from our previously stated target of 8% to 10%," company Chief Executive Mackey McDonald said.
